title: Human Review opens an HTML or Markdown file in your browser as an editable document
description:
Human Review opens an HTML or Markdown file in your browser as an editable document. Fix a sentence yourself, select a phrase and comment on it, click an image and comment on that, delete a section outright. Then hit Send and your agent receives every edit and comment as one batch rather than a paragraph of instructions it has to parse. Command-click links to review several pages before sending. Runs locally, no account, no API key. #github #opensource 

https://github.com/petergyang/human-review
